movelist.name: Harden
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Leaf Tornado
movelist.effect: Small or Medium targets in the central square of the blast are not hit. On 15+, all legal targets have their Accuracy lowered by -1.

movelist.name: Nature Power
movelist.effect: Nature Power uses a Move defined by the Environ keyword.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

movelist.name: Fake Out
movelist.effect: You may only use Fake Out with Priority upon joining an encounter; if you do, Fake Out Flinches the target. Switching out resets the requirement of joining an encounter.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.effect: While in Sunny Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Omen
abilities.effect: Choose a Pokémon or Trainer within 5 meters. The target’s Accuracy is lowered by 2.
